versos.grego: Ἔστιν δὲ πίστις ἐλπιζομένων ὑπόστασις, πραγμάτων ἔλεγχος οὐ βλεπομένων.

controles.web: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
controles.kjv: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
controles.livre: Ora, a fé é a certeza das coisas que se esperam, e a prova das coisas que não se veem.

versos.grego: ἐν ταύτῃ γὰρ ἐμαρτυρήθησαν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι.

controles.web: For by this, the elders obtained testimony.
controles.kjv: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
controles.livre: Pois por ela os antigos obtiveram testemunho.

versos.grego: Πίστει νοοῦμεν κατηρτίσθαι τοὺς αἰῶνας ῥήματι Θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ μὴ ἐκ φαινομένων τὸ βλεπόμενον γεγονέναι.

controles.web: By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
controles.kjv: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
controles.livre: Pela fé entendemos que o universo  foi aprontado pela palavra de Deus, de maneira que as coisas que se veem não foram feitas de algo visível.

versos.grego: Πίστει πλείονα θυσίαν Ἄβελ παρὰ Κάϊν προσήνεγκεν τῷ Θεῷ, δι’ ἧς ἐμαρτυρήθη εἶναι δίκαιος, μαρτυροῦντος ἐπὶ τοῖς δώροις αὐτοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ δι’ αὐτῆς ἀποθανὼν ἔτι λαλεῖ.

controles.web: By faith, Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
controles.kjv: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
controles.livre: Pela fé, Abel ofereceu a Deus melhor sacrifício do que Caim; por isso obteve testemunho de que era justo, pois Deus testemunhou de suas ofertas; e mesmo estando morto, ainda fala por meio dela.

versos.grego: Πίστει Ἐνὼχ μετετέθη τοῦ μὴ ἰδεῖν θάνατον, καὶ οὐχ ηὑρίσκετο διότι μετέθηκεν αὐτὸν ὁ Θεός. πρὸ γὰρ τῆς μεταθέσεως μεμαρτύρηται εὐαρεστηκέναι τῷ Θεῷ·

controles.web: By faith, Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
controles.kjv: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
controles.livre: Pela fé, Enoque foi transportado para não experimentar  a morte; e não foi achado, porque Deus havia o transportado; pois antes da transportação ele obteve testemunho de ter agradado a Deus.

versos.grego: χωρὶς δὲ πίστεως ἀδύνατον εὐαρεστῆσαι· πιστεῦσαι γὰρ δεῖ τὸν προσερχόμενον τῷ Θεῷ, ὅτι ἔστιν καὶ τοῖς ἐκζητοῦσιν αὐτὸν μισθαποδότης γίνεται.

controles.web: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
controles.kjv: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
controles.livre: Ora, sem fé é impossível agradar a Deus . Pois é necessário que aquele que se aproxima de Deus creia que ele existe, e que ele é recompensador dos que o buscam.

versos.grego: Πίστει χρηματισθεὶς Νῶε περὶ τῶν μηδέπω βλεπομένων, εὐλαβηθεὶς κατεσκεύασεν κιβωτὸν εἰς σωτηρίαν τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ, δι’ ἧς κατέκρινεν τὸν κόσμον, καὶ τῆς κατὰ πίστιν δικαιοσύνης ἐγένετο κληρονόμος.

controles.web: By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
controles.kjv: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
controles.livre: Pela fé, Noé, divinamente advertido das coisas que ainda se não viam, temeu; e, para salvamento de sua família construiu a arca. Por meio da fé  ele condenou o mundo, e foi feito herdeiro da justiça segundo a fé.

versos.grego: Πίστει καλούμενος Ἀβραὰμ ὑπήκουσεν ἐξελθεῖν εἰς τόπον ὃν ἤμελλεν λαμβάνειν εἰς κληρονομίαν, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν μὴ ἐπιστάμενος ποῦ ἔρχεται.

controles.web: By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
controles.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
controles.livre: Pela fé, Abraão, quando foi chamado para ir ao lugar que havia de receber por herança, obedeceu, e saiu sem que soubesse aonde ia.

versos.grego: Πίστει παρῴκησεν εἰς γῆν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ὡς ἀλλοτρίαν, ἐν σκηναῖς κατοικήσας, μετὰ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ τῶν συνκληρονόμων τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῆς αὐτῆς·

controles.web: By faith, he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
controles.kjv: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
controles.livre: Pela fé, ele habitou na terra de promessa, como em terra que não fosse sua, morando em tendas com Isaque e com Jacó, herdeiros com ele da mesma promessa.

versos.grego: ἐξεδέχετο γὰρ τὴν τοὺς θεμελίους ἔχουσαν πόλιν, ἧς τεχνίτης καὶ δημιουργὸς ὁ Θεός.

controles.web: For he looked for the city which has the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
controles.kjv: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
controles.livre: Pois ele esperava a cidade que tem fundamentos firmes, da qual o arquiteto e construtor é Deus.

versos.grego: Πίστει καὶ αὐτῇ Σάρρᾳ δύναμιν εἰς καταβολὴν σπέρματος ἔλαβεν καὶ παρὰ καιρὸν ἡλικίας, ἐπεὶ πιστὸν ἡγήσατο τὸν ἐπαγγειλάμενον.

controles.web: By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
controles.kjv: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
controles.livre: Pela fé, também, a própria Sara recebeu a capacidade de conceber descendência, e já na idade avançada , pois considerou fiel aquele que havia prometido.

versos.grego: διὸ καὶ ἀφ’ ἑνὸς ἐγεννήθησαν, καὶ ταῦτα νενεκρωμένου, καθὼς τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ πλήθει καὶ ὡς ἡ ἄμμος ἡ παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος τῆς θαλάσσης ἡ ἀναρίθμητος.

controles.web: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
controles.kjv: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
controles.livre: Assim, de um que estava à beira da morte, nasceu uma descendência numerosa como as estrelas do céu, e incontável como a areia na praia do mar.

versos.grego: Κατὰ πίστιν ἀπέθανον οὗτοι πάντες, μὴ κομισάμενοι τὰς ἐπαγγελίας, ἀλλὰ πόρρωθεν αὐτὰς ἰδόντες καὶ ἀσπασάμενοι, καὶ ὁμολογήσαντες ὅτι ξένοι καὶ παρεπίδημοί εἰσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

controles.web: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
controles.kjv: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
controles.livre: Permanecendo na fé, todos esses morreram sem receberem as promessas. Mas as viram de longe, e felicitaram-se nelas, declarando que eram estrangeiros e peregrinos na terra.

versos.grego: οἱ γὰρ τοιαῦτα λέγοντες ἐμφανίζουσιν ὅτι πατρίδα ἐπιζητοῦσιν.

controles.web: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
controles.kjv: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
controles.livre: Pois os que dizem tais coisas mostram claramente que estão buscando a sua própria pátria.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰ μὲν ἐκείνης ἐμνημόνευον ἀφ’ ἧς ἐξέβησαν, εἶχον ἂν καιρὸν ἀνακάμψαι·

controles.web: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
controles.kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
controles.livre: Ora, se estivessem pensando naquela de onde saíram, eles tinham oportunidade de voltar.

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ κρείττονος ὀρέγονται, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ἐπουρανίου. διὸ οὐκ ἐπαισχύνεται αὐτοὺς ὁ Θεὸς Θεὸς ἐπικαλεῖσθαι αὐτῶν· ἡτοίμασεν γὰρ αὐτοῖς πόλιν.

controles.web: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
controles.kjv: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
controles.livre: Mas agora desejam uma melhor, isto é, a celestial. Por isso Deus não se envergonha deles, de ser chamado o Deus deles, porque já lhes preparou uma cidade.

versos.grego: Πίστει προσενήνοχεν Ἀβραὰμ τὸν Ἰσαὰκ πειραζόμενος, καὶ τὸν μονογενῆ προσέφερεν ὁ τὰς ἐπαγγελίας ἀναδεξάμενος,

controles.web: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one and only son;
controles.kjv: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
controles.livre: Pela fé, Abraão, quando foi provado, ofereceu Isaque; aquele que havia recebido as promessas ofereceu o seu único filho,

versos.grego: πρὸς ὃν ἐλαλήθη ὅτι Ἐν Ἰσαὰκ κληθήσεταί σοι σπέρμα,

controles.web: even he to whom it was said, “In Isaac will your seed be called”;
controles.kjv: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
controles.livre: do qual foi dito: Em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência.

versos.grego: λογισάμενος ὅτι καὶ ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐγείρειν δυνατὸς ὁ Θεός· ὅθεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐν παραβολῇ ἐκομίσατο.

controles.web: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
controles.kjv: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
controles.livre: Abraão considerou que Deus era poderoso até para ressuscitar Isaque dos mortos; de onde também, de forma figurada, ele o recuperou.

versos.grego: Πίστει καὶ περὶ μελλόντων εὐλόγησεν Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακὼβ καὶ τὸν Ἠσαῦ.

controles.web: By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
controles.kjv: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
controles.livre: Pela fé, Isaque abençoou Jacó e Esaú quanto às coisas futuras.

versos.grego: Πίστει Ἰακὼβ ἀποθνῄσκων ἕκαστον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰωσὴφ εὐλόγησεν, καὶ προσεκύνησεν ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς ῥάβδου αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: By faith, Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
controles.kjv: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
controles.livre: Pela fé, Jacó, enquanto morria, abençoou a cada um dos filhos de José, e adorou apoiado sobre a ponta do seu cajado.

versos.grego: Πίστει Ἰωσὴφ τελευτῶν περὶ τῆς ἐξόδου τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐμνημόνευσεν καὶ περὶ τῶν ὀστέων αὐτοῦ ἐνετείλατο.

controles.web: By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave instructions concerning his bones.
controles.kjv: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
controles.livre: Pela fé, José, no fim de sua vida,  mencionou a saída dos filhos de Israel, e deu ordem acerca dos seus ossos.

versos.grego: Πίστει Μωϋσῆς γεννηθεὶς ἐκρύβη τρίμηνον ὑπὸ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ, διότι εἶδον ἀστεῖον τὸ παιδίον, καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸ διάταγμα τοῦ βασιλέως.

controles.web: By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
controles.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
controles.livre: Pela fé, Moisés, quando nasceu, foi escondido três meses pelos seus pais, pois viram que o menino era belo, e não se intimidaram com o mandamento do rei.

versos.grego: Πίστει Μωϋσῆς μέγας γενόμενος ἠρνήσατο λέγεσθαι υἱὸς θυγατρὸς Φαραώ,

controles.web: By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
controles.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
controles.livre: Pela fé, Moisés, sendo já crescido, recusou ser chamado filho da filha de faraó;

versos.grego: μᾶλλον ἑλόμενος συνκακουχεῖσθαι τῷ λαῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἢ πρόσκαιρον ἔχειν ἁμαρτίας ἀπόλαυσιν,

controles.web: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;
controles.kjv: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
controles.livre: pois preferiu ser maltratado com o povo de Deus a ter por um tempo o prazer do pecado.

versos.grego: μείζονα πλοῦτον ἡγησάμενος τῶν Αἰγύπτου θησαυρῶν τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν τοῦ Χριστοῦ· ἀπέβλεπεν γὰρ εἰς τὴν μισθαποδοσίαν.

controles.web: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
controles.kjv: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
controles.livre: Ele considerou que as humilhações por causa de Cristo eram riquezas maiores que os tesouros do Egito; pois sua atenção estava fixada na recompensa.

versos.grego: Πίστει κατέλιπεν Αἴγυπτον, μὴ φοβηθεὶς τὸν θυμὸν τοῦ βασιλέως· τὸν γὰρ ἀόρατον ὡς ὁρῶν ἐκαρτέρησεν.

controles.web: By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
controles.kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
controles.livre: Pela fé, ele deixou o Egito sem temer a ira do rei, pois perseverou como que vendo aquele que é invisível.

versos.grego: Πίστει πεποίηκεν τὸ πάσχα καὶ τὴν πρόσχυσιν τοῦ αἵματος, ἵνα μὴ ὁ ὀλοθρεύων τὰ πρωτότοκα θίγῃ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
controles.kjv: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
controles.livre: Pela fé, ele celebrou a Páscoa e o derramamento do sangue, para que o destruidor dos primogênitos não os tocasse.

versos.grego: Πίστει διέβησαν τὴν Ἐρυθρὰν Θάλασσαν ὡς διὰ ξηρᾶς γῆς, ἧς πεῖραν λαβόντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι κατεπόθησαν.

controles.web: By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
controles.kjv: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
controles.livre: Pela fé, atravessaram o mar Vermelho, como que por terra seca, o que, quando os Egípcios tentaram, afogaram-se.

versos.grego: Πίστει τὰ τείχη Ἰερειχὼ ἔπεσαν κυκλωθέντα ἐπὶ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας.

controles.web: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.
controles.kjv: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
controles.livre: Pela fé, os muros de Jericó caíram, depois de serem rodeados por sete dias.

versos.grego: Πίστει Ῥαὰβ ἡ πόρνη οὐ συναπώλετο τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν, δεξαμένη τοὺς κατασκόπους μετ’ εἰρήνης.

controles.web: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
controles.kjv: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
controles.livre: Pela fé, Raabe, a prostituta, não pereceu com os incrédulos,  pois acolheu em paz os espias.

versos.grego: Καὶ τί ἔτι λέγω; ἐπιλείψει με γὰρ διηγούμενον ὁ χρόνος περὶ Γεδεών, Βαράκ, Σαμψών, Ἰεφθάε, Δαυείδ τε καὶ Σαμουὴλ καὶ τῶν προφητῶν,

controles.web: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;
controles.kjv: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
controles.livre: E que mais direi? Pois me faltará tempo se eu contar a respeito de Gideão, Baraque, e também de Sansão, Jefté, Davi, e também de Samuel e dos profetas.

versos.grego: οἳ διὰ πίστεως κατηγωνίσαντο βασιλείας, ἠργάσαντο δικαιοσύνην, ἐπέτυχον ἐπαγγελιῶν, ἔφραξαν στόματα λεόντων,

controles.web: who, through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
controles.kjv: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
controles.livre: Pela fé, esses venceram reinos, exercitaram justiça, alcançaram promessas,  fecharam bocas de leões,

versos.grego: ἔσβεσαν δύναμιν πυρός, ἔφυγον στόματα μαχαίρης, ἐδυναμώθησαν ἀπὸ ἀσθενείας, ἐγενήθησαν ἰσχυροὶ ἐν πολέμῳ, παρεμβολὰς ἔκλιναν ἀλλοτρίων.

controles.web: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
controles.kjv: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
controles.livre: apagaram o poder do fogo, escaparam do fio de espada, da fraqueza tiraram forças, tonaram-se fortes na batalha, puseram em fuga os exércitos dos estrangeiros;

versos.grego: ἔλαβον γυναῖκες ἐξ ἀναστάσεως τοὺς νεκροὺς αὐτῶν· ἄλλοι δὲ ἐτυμπανίσθησαν, οὐ προσδεξάμενοι τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν, ἵνα κρείττονος ἀναστάσεως τύχωσιν·

controles.web: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
controles.kjv: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
controles.livre: As mulheres receberam de volta os seus mortos pela ressurreição; e outros foram torturados, não aceitando a soltura, para alcançarem uma melhor ressurreição;

versos.grego: ἕτεροι δὲ ἐμπαιγμῶν καὶ μαστίγων πεῖραν ἔλαβον, ἔτι δὲ δεσμῶν καὶ φυλακῆς·

controles.web: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
controles.kjv: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
controles.livre: e outros experimentaram provação de insultos e açoites, e até correntes e prisões;

versos.grego: ἐλιθάσθησαν, ἐπειράσθησαν, ἐπρίσθησαν, ἐν φόνῳ μαχαίρης ἀπέθανον, περιῆλθον ἐν μηλωταῖς, ἐν αἰγείοις δέρμασιν, ὑστερούμενοι, θλιβόμενοι, κακουχούμενοι,

controles.web: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated
controles.kjv: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
controles.livre: foram apedrejados, tentados, serrados, morreram pela espada; andaram vestidos de peles de ovelhas e de cabras; necessitados, afligidos, maltratados;

versos.grego: ὧν οὐκ ἦν ἄξιος ὁ κόσμος, ἐπὶ ἐρημίαις πλανώμενοι καὶ ὄρεσιν καὶ σπηλαίοις καὶ ταῖς ὀπαῖς τῆς γῆς.

controles.web: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
controles.kjv: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
controles.livre: (o mundo não era digno deles) andando sem rumo em desertos, montanhas, covas, e nas cavernas da terra.

versos.grego: Καὶ οὗτοι πάντες μαρτυρηθέντες διὰ τῆς πίστεως οὐκ ἐκομίσαντο τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν,

controles.web: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
controles.kjv: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
controles.livre: E todos esses, mesmo tendo testemunho pela fé, não alcançaram a promessa,

versos.grego: τοῦ Θεοῦ περὶ ἡμῶν κρεῖττόν τι προβλεψαμένου, ἵνα μὴ χωρὶς ἡμῶν τελειωθῶσιν.

controles.web: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
controles.kjv: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
controles.livre: pois Deus havia preparado algo melhor para nós, para que, sem nós, eles não fossem aperfeiçoados.
